task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-04 at src/design/adp-04-user-tenant-binding.md. Specify additive tenant binding for user records: user.tenant_id UUID NOT NULL with default tenant backfill, single-tenant membership semantics, migration/backfill behavior for pre-existing users, and identity-service/repository contract updates required for tenant-aware reads and writes. Include explicit compatibility constraints for IDN-01 and IDN-02, traceability to ADP-02 tenant column patterns, and boundaries to avoid cross-tenant leakage in user/group operations. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines schema and migration semantics for user tenant_id with default-tenant compatibility
Single-tenant user membership invariants are explicit and testable
Identity repository/service contract changes are implementation-ready
Cross-tenant isolation expectations for identity operations are clearly specified
Traceability maps ADP-04 behavior to IDN-01, IDN-02, and ADP-02

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-04 user tenant binding, defining additive users.tenant_id default-tenant backfill semantics, single-tenant membership invariants, tenant-aware identity service/repository contracts, and cross-tenant isolation boundaries with IDN-01/IDN-02 compatibility and ADP-02 traceability.
